gallery.title: Keyword Flow Ribbons
gallery.description: Eight Sankey bands are filled with dense semantic word clouds packed directly inside each curved ribbon silhouette.

file.name: keyword_flows.csv + flow_keywords.csv
file.description: Eight weighted stage transitions and 24 meaningful, weighted keywords keyed to every source-target pair.

bindings.role: Nested Word Cloud text and size

gallery.composition: Nest Word Cloud into every Sankey link mark. Each parent mark is sampled into an arbitrary binary mask, then an integral-occupancy layout packs the source-target vocabulary inside that exact region and clips the resulting SVG text to its silhouette.

editorHelp.introduction: The starter provides one bound Sankey and one bound Word Cloud using the same graph dataset.

steps.title: Explain every ribbon
steps.action: Nest across all links; source and target are inherited as child filters.
steps.result: Every band receives its own 24-keyword semantic cloud, adaptively packed and clipped to the curved ribbon rather than a rectangular child frame.
